recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. If future changes to the additive extension are needed, make them in the FHIR Extension Pack and keep the core OID registry aligned.
issue_request: FHIR-40643 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested a repeatable specimen-additive extension whose value is CodeableReference(Substance), with the accepted modification adding contexts for both Specimen and Specimen.container.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was pre-applied in git 948c1e6. That commit is in HL7/fhir-extensions and added StructureDefinition-specimen-additive.xml plus ValueSet-specimen-additive.xml; later Extension Pack commits adjusted status, work group metadata, OIDs, and experimental flags without changing the accepted extension contexts or value shape.
additional_context: The 2023-03-20 OO Specimen minutes state that the extension was added because Specimen core could not be changed for R5, that extensions are managed in the FHIR Extension Pack, and that the extension was added at both Specimen and Specimen.container. Current core has OID registry entries for the additive StructureDefinition and ValueSet but no in-scope extension definition source.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current Extension Pack source contains the requested extension and value set, so adding a core definition would duplicate ownership rather than correct the current specification.

related_jiras.note: A later duplicate Substance/SubstanceDefinition issue changed core Specimen.processing.additive, but it does not change the R5 specimen-additive extension ownership decision.
